Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
The impact you will create 
Support the development of a high-performance and stable cloud platform based on OpenStack, with a focus on networking
Contribute to opensource projects (e.g. Open vSwitch/OVN/Linux Kernel/Openstack) by developing cloud networking features, improving performance, and fixing bugs
Conduct detailed troubleshooting and root cause analysis to identify sustainable solutions
Ensure efficient automation and continuous optimization of technical process workflows
Implement comprehensive observability through metrics, tracing, and structured logging for rapid debugging and performance analysis
 Experience And Skills You Will Need
You have solid experience with Linux and Containerization(Kubernetes, Docker), and keep up to date with new developments in these areas
You have hands-on experience with Software Defined Networking technologies such as Open vSwitch/OVN and Calico
You have strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with a structured approach to diagnosing and resolving issues
You are proficient in programming and scripting, particularly in C/C++, Python, and Bash
You have worked with virtualization and containerization environments and understand their practical applications
Comfortable in a fast-growing, dynamic environment, especially where processes are still developing
You are a proactive team player and look for ways to drive growth for yourself and your team
Effective communicator, with the ability to clearly express complex ideas in both written and verbal formats.
